title: Committed review-diff.txt is a stale pre-r1-fold snapshot that contradicts the shipped audio code
evidence: _bmad-output/reviews/v2-ambience/review-diff.txt:211 -> `+	duck_ratio := MUSIC_DUCK_VOLUME / MUSIC_VOLUME`  vs  app/audio/audio.odin:529 -> `	duck_ratio := min(MUSIC_DUCK_VOLUME / MUSIC_VOLUME, 1.0)`; and the sibling committed artifact admits it — _bmad-output/reviews/v2-ambience/verif-gap.txt:186 -> ` - The reviewed review-diff.txt is stale relative to the working tree: the tree already folds r1 fixes`
detail: The repo commits a 32KB pre-fold diff snapshot showing the uncapped duck multiplier the shipped code capped (its own verif-gap.txt flags the staleness). Future archaeology against this in-repo 'diff' finds phantom bugs; raw session transcripts add chrome.
recommended_fix: Regenerate review-diff.txt from the final tree (or drop it) before merge; trim terminal chrome from the transcripts, keeping the curated findings sections.
